issues.failure_explanation: The caption of Figure~\ref{fig: mult hole flux}, which shows the three trefoil-shaped holes, claims the computed solution error is below $10^{-13}$. Example~2 of the same paper reports, for exactly this trefoil example, $E = 4.2995\times 10^{-8}$ (square torus) and $E = 4.2994\times 10^{-8}$ (equilateral torus); the $10^{-13}$ level matches only the circular-hole variant ($2\times10^{-13}$).

failure_location.quote: The error of the computed solution is less than $10^{-13}$, away from a small neighborhood of the boundary.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the caption to the trefoil error reported in the text (e.g., 'less than $10^{-7}$' or quote $4.3\times10^{-8}$).
issues.overall_effect: Only the figure caption's accuracy claim is false; the text, the flux table, and all formal results are unaffected.
issues.title: Figure caption overstates the trefoil-hole solution error by five orders of magnitude
issues.why_classification: A one-line caption correction to the value already reported in the text; no theorem, method, rate, or guarantee is affected.

issues.failure_explanation: From \eqref{eqn: green}, $\vartheta_1(w)=\vartheta_1'(0)w+O(w^3)$ gives $G(w) = -\frac{1}{2\pi}\log|w| - \frac{\log|\vartheta_1'(0)|}{2\pi} + O(|w|^2)$, i.e. the constant is $-c$, not $+c$. The appendix's own computation $\log|\hat\sigma(z)| = -\frac{\pi\Im(z)^2}{b}+\log|\vartheta_1(z)|-\log|\vartheta_1'(0)|$ yields $G = -\frac{1}{2\pi}\log|\hat\sigma| - c$, contradicting the stated \eqref{e:SigmaHat}. The Steklov discretization implicitly uses the correct sign (the $S^k_2$ diagonal $-\frac{h^k_1}{2\pi}\log|z^{k\prime}_1||\vartheta_1'(0)|$ equals $-\frac{1}{2\pi}\log|z^{k\prime}_1|-c$), so the theory and the paper's own numerics are inconsistent.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Flip the sign of $c$ in (e:SigmaHat) and in the expansion $G(z-\xi) = -\frac{1}{2\pi}\log|z-\xi| - c + O(|z-\xi|^2)$ (two one-character edits).
issues.overall_effect: The displayed representation (e:SigmaHat), the expansion (e:green approx), and the Section~2 asymptotic are false as stated; no proof uses the sign of the constant (only differences and derivatives of $G$ enter), so all theorems and the numerical implementation survive.
issues.title: Sign error in the modified Weierstrass sigma representation of G and in the local expansion of G
issues.why_classification: Local sign fix; every substantive claim, proof, and the numerical implementation (which already uses the correct sign) is preserved.

issues.failure_explanation: Since $z-\bar z = 2i\Im z$, one has $\frac{(z-\bar z)^2}{8b} = -\frac{(\Im z)^2}{2b}$, so the stated $f_G$ satisfies $\Re f_G = -\frac{1}{2\pi}\log|\vartheta_1(z)| - \frac{(\Im z)^2}{2b} \neq G$; the verification in the proof drops the factor $i$ in $z-\bar z = 2i\Im z$. The correct choice is $f_G(z) = -\frac{1}{2\pi}\log\vartheta_1(z) - \frac{(z-\bar z)^2}{8b}$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change the sign of the second term in $f_G$ (one character).
issues.overall_effect: Item (3) of Lemma~\ref{lem: Complex layer} is false as stated; $f_G$ is not used in any other result, so nothing downstream is affected.
issues.title: Stated f_G does not satisfy G = Re f_G (sign error in the (z - zbar)^2 term)
issues.why_classification: One-character sign repair; the item is auxiliary and unused elsewhere, so no substantive content is lost.
